0|af34770e55fd899c96d8d73bdc04dbc956096650|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"mm: reduce rmap overhead for ex-KSM page copies created on swap faults
When ex-KSM pages are faulted from swap cache
capable of re-establishing anon_vma-spanning KSM pages.  In this case
copy of the page is created instead
column2: just like during a COW break.

column1: These freshly made copies are known to be exclusive to the faulting VMA
and there is no reason to go look for this page in parent and sibling
processes during rmap operations.
Use page_add_new_anon_rmap() for these copies.  This also puts them on
the proper LRU lists and marks them SwapBacked
column2: so we can get rid of

column1: doing this ad-hoc in the KSM copy code.
